Categories.Title: Military sims
Categories.Note: Infantry sims with aircraft and helicopters: JoyPro writes only the cataloged aircraft and helicopter actions.

xbox.Note: Every game can be switched to the virtual Xbox pad, but JoyPro knows no pad layout of this game: it puts your inputs on free pad controls and you bind those in the game (rarely needed for a game that reads joysticks).
